description: Angular service class 'DeviceService' responsible for managing and fetching device information from a backend server, including device lists and individual device details.

classes.name: DeviceService
classes.description: Angular service that provides device data management, including fetching device lists, filtering by group id, and retrieving device information.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Triggers a refresh of the device list by emitting a new value on the refreshSubject.

methods.name: setGroupId
methods.description: Sets the current device group ID, which triggers device list update.

methods.name: getDevices
methods.description: Returns an Observable stream of the device list, possibly filtered by group ID.

methods.name: getDeviceInfo
methods.description: Fetches detailed information for a specific device by device ID.
